articles.title: Sky's USDS stablecoin shrinks 35% as $1.5 billion exits reserves after illicit-finance report
articles.snippet: USDS held its $1 peg as a large holder linked to Poloniex withdrew much of decentralized protocol Sky's USDC liquidity backing its stablecoins.

articles.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
articles.snippet: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.
